subject: Tube anemone
topic: This feathery flower on the seafloor is actually an animal.
script:
This feathery flower on the seafloor is actually an animal.
It's a tube anemone.
It isn't a true sea anemone, just a distant relative.
It has two rings of tentacles: long ones on the outside, and short ones around its mouth.
And it lives inside a tube it builds for itself.
The tube is made of mucus and special threads that it fires out from its own cells.
Most of its body stays hidden in that tube, buried in the mud.
If danger comes close, it can pull back inside in a flash.
The rest of the time, its sticky tentacles catch tiny bits of food drifting by.
Would you have guessed this was an animal?
pkg_title: This 'Flower' Is an Animal That Lives in a TUBE 🌸 #Shorts
